ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Disqualified")), ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Qualified"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Engage")), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", NOT($CustomMetadata.Trigger_Framework_Config_CC__mdt.Lead.Bypass_Validation_CC__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Lead can only be marked as Qualified when its previous status is Engage.
